summary: We developed Garmir, an advanced Mars EVA Navigation & Telemetry platform designed to assist astronauts during extravehicular activities (EVAs). The solution features a web-based interactive interface complete with a live telemetry dashboard, navigation tools, crew profile management, and an integrated satellite companion assistant. It directly addresses critical mission operations challenges by providing real-time data tracking and structured guidance to keep astronauts safe and efficient in high-risk extraterrestrial environments. This is vital for mission success because ensuring crew safety, health, and situational awareness bridges the gap between complex telemetry data and actionable insights, ultimately reducing risks for explorers operating far from Earth
details:
GARMIR OS: A Navigation and Support System for Mars Exploration Missions

What does the project do and how does it work?

Garmir OS is a web application that we developed to help plan and manage exploration missions on the surface of Mars. It focuses especially on Extravehicular Activities (EVAs), which happen when astronauts leave their vehicles or habitats to explore the planet.

The application allows users to create astronaut profiles, choose different types of transport, and plan routes in different areas of Mars, such as Mawrth Vallis and Jezero Crater. Using maps and navigation tools, users can study the terrain and calculate routes by considering factors such as elevation, ground slopes, possible dangers, and scientific interest.

The application also compares different routes to find safer options or areas that may be more interesting for scientific research. It can also estimate mission duration, oxygen consumption, energy use, and the physical effort required from astronauts. In addition, it includes an exploration logbook where users can save observations and mark the locations of geological samples. It also has a virtual assistant that helps users during mission planning.

What benefits does it have?

Garmir OS brings different planning and monitoring tools together in one platform. This allows users to study a mission from different points of view instead of only considering the distance between two locations.

One of its main benefits is that it helps identify possible terrain problems and compare routes according to their risks and scientific goals. It can also estimate important resources, such as available oxygen, travel time, and the physical effort needed to complete a route.

In this way, we aim to make mission planning easier and provide a better understanding of the challenges of exploring Mars.

What is the intended impact of the project?

Our goal with Garmir OS is to show how technology can help with the planning of future space missions and the exploration of difficult environments. We want to bring together geographic information, resource calculations, and navigation tools in an interactive and easy-to-use experience.

Although Garmir OS is a simulation and decision-support tool, and not a certified system for real space missions, it helps users understand the different factors that should be considered when planning an EVA on Mars.

The project also has an educational purpose. We want to make topics such as space exploration, planetary geography, engineering, and mission planning easier to understand through a practical application.

What tools, programming languages, hardware, or software did we use?

We developed Garmir OS with the help of artificial intelligence tools. We did not have advanced programming knowledge, so we used AI to turn our original idea into a web application. We explained what we wanted, gave instructions, reviewed the results, and asked for changes until the application was closer to our original vision.

The application uses web technologies such as HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. It also uses tools and libraries such as Three.js and WebGL for 3D graphics, Canvas for visual elements, SVG for animated components, and React for parts of the interface. It also includes features such as local data storage, file reading and exporting, and device orientation sensors on compatible devices.

Artificial intelligence played an important role in our development process. It allowed us to work on a complex technology project without having to write all the code ourselves. Our main contribution was creating the idea, choosing the goals and features, explaining our plans to the AI, checking the results, and deciding what needed to be improved.

How is the project creative?

Garmir is creative because it combines different parts of a space mission in one wb app. It does not only show a map of Mars. It also includes navigation, route planning, terrain analysis, resource estimates, and a system for recording scientific discoveries.

Another original feature is Garmir, an animated virtual assistant that guides users and reacts to different mission situations. Its design aims to make the experience friendlier and more interactive while keeping the scientific and technological focus of the project.

Using artificial intelligence during development also helped us turn an idea that seemed difficult to create into an interactive application, even though we did not have advanced programming experience.

What factors did we consider when developing the project?

While developing Garmir OS, we considered different factors related to the conditions on Mars and the needs of astronauts during an exploration mission.

These factors include Martian gravity, which is about 38% of Earth's gravity; terrain elevation and slopes; dangers caused by steep surfaces; surface radiation; very low temperatures; and limited oxygen supplies. We also considered the weight of the spacesuit, the astronaut's physical condition, the type of transport used, and the total distance of a round trip.

We included these factors so that mission planning would not depend only on distance. Instead, it would also consider the different challenges of exploring the Martian surface.

Conclusion

Garmir OS is a project that combines space exploration, technology, and artificial intelligence to create an interactive tool for planning missions on Mars. Developing it was also a learning experience for our team. With the help of AI, we were able to develop our own idea, choose its features, and turn it into a web application without needing advanced programming knowledge. This project shows how artificial intelligence can create new opportunities and help people with different levels of technical experience turn their ideas into digital projects.
